newsitem.title: USA: EVEREN sells four mln shares at $18.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: EVEREN sells four mln shares at $18.50/shr.

text.p: EVEREN Capital Corp said Tuesday four million of its common shares were sold, priced at $18.50 per share, in an initial public offering.
It said underwriters were granted the right to buy up to an additional 600,000 shares to cover overallotments.
The offering involves only newly issued shares offered and sold by the company.

Following the offering, about 15.7 million shares of EVEREN Capital Corp common stock will be outstanding, and EVEREN employees and management will continue to own about 75 percent of the company's common stock.

About $36 million of the net proceeds to be received from the stock sale will be used to repay certain bank debt. The rest will go towards general corporate purposes, including potential future acquisitions.
EVEREN Capital is the parent of EVEREN Securities Inc, a brokerage firm with 138 offices in 27 states, and EVEREN Clearing Corp, which provides securities execution services.
